name: Het 4e Gymnasium
description: Paul de Ruiter Architects designed this school as an early anchor for the Houthaven redevelopment. Its coloured enamel glass and projecting wooden sun frames distinguish the classroom facades; two gym halls and a roof terrace occupy the upper level.
facts: Completed in 2016 for roughly 800 secondary-school pupils; BAG records construction year2015.
The west schoolyard entrance leads to an atrium used for lunch and theatre. A separate south entrance serves the partly sunken bicycle store.
The upper sports halls have a separate entrance so clubs and the neighbourhood can use them outside school hours.
